Figma crossed $1B ARR
growing a stunning 41%
With $100m+ of net income
And 24% free cash flow margins
Just … wow.  Many of the public B2B and SaaS leaders may be struggling, in low growth mode.  But the best of it?  On fire.

#1. Enterprise Customers Continue to Accelerate at Scale
The Numbers
:
1,119 customers paying $100K+ ARR, up from 963 last quarter (+16% QoQ growth). This segment now represents the fastest-growing customer cohort.
Why This Matters
:

Takeaway
:
Track your $100K+ ACV customers as a separate cohort early. At scale, this becomes your primary growth engine.
